Book and Curriculum are existing surfaces; Writings and Talks are projected here — a sparse list per record. Each record renders ONLY the fields present. A `slides`/`pdf` path is relative to the repo root and MUST resolve on disk (checked by check_resources() at validate); a `url` is an external link. Grows by adding one record — no page surgery.
